 facts.capture_viewport_consistent=JSON.stringify(facts.viewport)===JSON.stringify(facts.viewport_after_capture);
 facts.capture_state_consistent=facts.snapshot===facts.snapshot_after_capture&&facts.capture_viewport_consistent;
 facts.capture_geometry.state_consistent=facts.capture_state_consistent;
 facts.capture_method=true?'visible-page-cdp':'page-screenshot';
 return facts;
})(page);
